The sheer amount of reused assets in this is insane. But what's worse is pairing that with a disgusting 40$ DEMO that doesn't even give access to the full game. The 60$ edition of a game made almost entirely upon the back of recycled assets from multiple games is the full edition. Not bonus content. Full access to normal content. That is downright disgusting, and the fact people will defend it is worse. They couldn't even be bothered to animate the story cutscenes. They're dialogue over still images. 10 minutes in, you not only see reused enemies and copy-pasted buildings, but even reused dialogue from bosses. This is, without a doubt, FromSoft seeing exactly how low they can set the bar for people to eat it up and preach its brilliance. This is disgusting. This is where we are. Soulless. Low effort. Full price.

I completely undestand this is something you would get and learn by playing the game, but it feels awful. If you don't bum rush you will get so far behind you get immediately one-shot by the boss. If you do bum rush though, you have no chance of learning or understanding anything. I like difficult boss fights, but the battle-royale circle rush fiesta really doesn't work, at least not for me.

Impossible to make progress without voice chat. If you have 3 friends you can talk to and play regularly, you will have a great time, the connection is smooth, the map is full of events and the game loop is very interesting. However I am a 41 year old man and I don't have friends to regularly play this with, let alone 2 others (you need 3 people to go in as a team, 2 won't work either). Even if they bring voice chat in the game (i'm not sure how there isn't one at the moment) you won't really enjoy this as much as if you were trying to fight with buddies, as your responsiveness with randoms will affect how you feel about your game a lot. Playing it solo queue with randoms is hard, it's hard to communicate, it's hard to share items, it's hard to discuss tactics or decide on the next area to farm, it's just hard. TL;DR, if you don't have 2 more friends you can group up with regularly, it's not fun. [b]Edit: So after 421 comments and 379 clown emojis as of writing this review, I'd just like to point out that I never expected this review to be this controversial, so I'd like to clarify a couple of points...[/b] Not having friends who want to play nightreign is not the same as having no friends, not everybody is excited about this sort of game. Furthermore, I'm not going to go and join random discords to try and find 2 other people that I may click with. With regards to skill issue for solo play, yeah, no ♥♥♥♥ I'm not good enough to beat the game in solo mode, I'd gather most people aren't... not sure why this is a talking point though when the game is clearly meant to be played coop. I mentioned this in a few comments the day I posted this review but I find having no voice chat availability in a coop game and no way to ping items in a game about sharing items to be unacceptable in the year of our lord, 2025. You don't need to play for 20 hours to realise that voice chat is important in a game like this, two runs at 1.2 hours in showed me well enough that the game simply is not fun at all for me, unless you have two friends to play with. And as a final point, I have recieved so many friend offers and people actually messaging me to tell me not to be worried about all the negative comments (which was honestly very unexpected and kinda sweet), and I would say that despite what everything looks like in the comments, souls community is still one of the best in my book. I'm honestly not bothered by the comments, I find them quite funny honestly and some of them aren't even wrong. I love the souls games and have been playing them (badly) for almost 15 years now, I wish this game clicked with me, I really did, but it didn't. Poor tools for communication in a game about cooperation and teamwork is not acceptable. I will repeat once again, and if you disagree with this point, then good for you, it doesn't work for me though, and I have no problems telling people in my review about it. Enjoy the game, happy hunting.

I was very excited about this game, but I can't recommend it at the moment. - The lack of 2-player cooperation is a shame in a game designed for cooperation, I don't mind playing with strangers but the lack of communication tools makes managing random players a pain - The resurrection system is a big miss; hitting your friends is far too tedious, and I'd have preferred to have to hold down a button for 10 seconds - The overall gameplay is much more clankier than Elden Ring's, it seems the developers have removed a lot of animation cancels which means you often feel quite heavy and in the thick of battle you often die from being stunlocked by your own animations - I didn't get very far but the lack of character choice is disheartening, it doesn't seem you can customize them (except with relics) or unlock others, with so many reused assets from Elden Ring I was expecting a lot of choice but sadly this isn't the case - The lack of settings is also strange for such an big game in 2025, no 120fps setting, you can't change your FOV, no wide option, no DLSS - No crossplay - But my biggest problem by far is the general readability, no mini-map, you have to constantly open the map to understand what's going on around you, it's so hard to understand when the area is going to shrink, where your friends are, the compass at the top of the screen is pretty bad and hard to read If they ever improve the game I'll be glad to try it again and change my review but so far it seems like a badly designed idea made from the scraps of a good game which you can still probably like if you have 2 friends always available to play with, which is not my case

Great game if you have short term memory loss making it feel like a new experience every run. Edit: I beat it. It's still ass.

elden ring nightreign and a mcdonald's cheeseburger both have a lot in common. they're both processed slop with virtually no passion put behind them. the cheeseburger is good in the fleeting moment where you first eat it, it scratches an itch and hits the spot - nightreign is similar in that way. it is the type of slop that i crave and find myself actively wanting occasionally, despite knowing it is bad for me. much like a mcdonald's cheeseburger, nightreign is high in fat and sodium. no matter how much you enjoy it, it will clog your arteries and kill you eventually.
This game needs a duos option, cross-play and voice chat.. In a multiplayer focused game these things really shouldn't have been left out.

As of right now, its really only worth it if you are a[i] massive [/i]fan of souls-like games. It can for sure be fixed with a few patches, but right now this game is just unrealized potential. Here's what's good: - Pace feels good - Characters are distinct and the abilities are fun Here's what needs improvement: - Drops are not great. 95% of what you get doesn't matter - Enemies are overtuned. EVERY boss is a sponge and do way too much damage unless you've played near-optimal up to that point - It can get a bit repetitive at times. All rougelikes are to a certain extent, but after a few hours, you've legitimately seen everything there is to offer besides a few bosses. Here's what is bad: - Relics are terrible. The vast majority do almost nothing, and the ones that actually do something are still nearly useless. This is the main method of progression as they are supposed to allow for an increase in strength between runs, but it just doesn't work. - No two player - Matchmaking often doesn't work - Single player is miserable

Nightreign is an unevenly microwaved hot pocket. The edges are scalding and the center is frozen solid, and so for the most part eating it is a miserable experience. But the problem is, right at the border between the hot and cold sections? There's a bite or two that's just perfect Oh, but also sometimes it's just full of broken glass and gravel. This is either the most i've ever enjoyed a game i hate, or the most i've ever hated a game i enjoy. I just don't know which. A few rounds of balance patches will probably help a lot, but i also feel like there are so many big structural issues that just can't be easily fixed. I think the core problem is it forgets the thing that makes Souls difficulty actually work: no matter how many times a boss kills you with cheap BS, you can just throw yourself at it again and again until you figure it out. Here, each of those runbacks takes 45 minutes.

说白了，你们也就在网上说说了，现实里谁不想在上了一天的班之后急头白脸开一把黑夜君临，在深度三猛猛游龙。 一查成分是外国队友，打开遗物是四块大饼和意义不明没有任何加属攻物攻的深夜遗物，没有老寒腿和入侵监牢，没有毒爆的铁眼和没有地火的追。 刚落地队友就标了十万八千里的血瓶，好不容易升三开的第一个监牢是红皮兽人群。然后硬打毒池入侵不敌小怪，最后一缩二级，靠着不想扣400的踹哈精神一个人马赢双黑夜骑兵。 第二天鏖战山妖城，队友正走大门拉仇恨导致第一只山妖拖了两分钟。好消息是队友都拿到了光环镰刀，坏消息是楼顶的红皮黑剑缩完圈也没能拿下最后无奈放生。 来来回回往返跑只能十级进第二夜，无名一阶段起飞一口火直接将两只队友炼化成烤乳猪，好在魂三被校长军训过以及练习弹过无名还是过了第二夜。 进夜王战门口仍在幻想人马这种安卓夜王低等级一样能打，一看队友装备人均私藏一个满减和减仇恨，自己辛辛苦苦半天唯一加攻的词条是仙豆剑。 夜王战依旧毫无悬念，队友在后排猛猛复读战技不断插地光矛被穿成猪肉串，蒸了一个小时最后还是逃离不了好结局。 辛辛苦苦攒几十万暗痕下去打水漂。默默关掉游戏打开手机看某五字主播打黑环，看到灵机一动坐在蝎子旁躲红虫激光雨，嘉豪跳大被天基炮逮捕，依旧不敌严父超越之光。意识到原来黑环也可以玩的这么搞笑，看完仍对这个游戏抱有一丝希望，没准自己努努力一路连胜也能到深五呢
还有什么比晚上下班回家打开一把深夜对局，排到惊人的卡比然后四级打监牢遇到雷霆噩兆老师压级入侵，完了打不过错失进主城机会，结果六级打第一夜boss，拼尽全力终于拿了一把尸山血海能爽一爽结果最后被冰龙一个孕吐直接灭队还要开心的事呢

THIS GAME NEEDS MORE CONTENT. DON T LET NIGHTEREIGN DIE. I am leaving this negative review because FromSoftware and Bandai Namco have completely abandoned Elden Ring Nightreign. This game has a brilliant cooperative and roguelite foundation, but it severely lacks variety. We are feeling completely left behind. We supported this project from day one, and instead of giving it the long-term content and updates it deserves, the developers dropped a couple of minor patches and walked away to focus on other franchises. Just because FromSoftware has achieved massive success with Dark Souls and the main Elden Ring game doesn't mean they can treat players of their spin-offs as secondary customers. This absolute lack of post-launch support heavily damages the studio's prestige and reputation. We DO NOT WANT this game to die. Nightreign is the premier "I want to play a SOULS game, but I don't want to commit to an entire playthrough" game. It's quick, it's challenging, it has enough content to satisfy people who get bored with things quickly, and it has enough depth to squeeze several hundred hours out of it for the people who really want to dig in. At the time of this review, I have a save file with 160 hours with all achievements that has reached Depth 4, without the Forsaken Hollows DLC. If the gameplay trailers don't sell the concept well: Nightreign is a fast-paced cooperative Roguelite boss rush where the core gameplay loop is a run that takes anywhere from 15 to 50 minutes (average 40 mins) depending on how fast or slow you win or lose. You select a Nightfarer, a character that comes with their own unique abilities and stat spreads, and then you group with up to two other players to challenge one of the Nightlords of your choice. During the run, you have two 'days' to search the map for ways to get stronger: enemies killed grant you level ups, and bosses killed grant you randomly generated weapons or permanent buffs. After 7 minutes of daytime, your play area will gradually shrink, forcing you to maneuver towards a zone where you fight a more powerful boss. After defeating the boss, the 'day' ends, your play area resets, and the next 'day' begins. On the third day, you do not get any more chances to grow stronger, and instead are thrown into a fight against the final boss of the run: a Nightlord. Regardless of win or loss, you are awarded with a currency and a few relics (permanent upgrades that persist through runs), though victory always rewards more. In the base game, there are 8 Nightlords, 5 maps, and 8 Nightfarers (6 at the start, two unlocked later). The Nightlords are tricky enough that they take multiple attempts to master, the maps have enough hidden secrets that you'll still find something new every run, and the Nightfarer's abilities provide a lot of room for mastery, such that even after 100 hours you'll still be learning new techniques. Seven of the Nightlords come with more difficult variants, known as "Everdarks", that pose a significantly greater challenge over their base form. The worst part of the game is easily the lobby area and the meta progression. The Roundtable Hold is a place where you spend resources earned in a run towards unlocking permanent power-ups for your future runs, or where you unlock cosmetic items for your Nightfarers. Each Nightfarer comes with their own mini-story, told in the form of "Remembrance" quests that have 4-5 steps each, and they're just long enough to give some charm to what would otherwise just be caricatures of popular Souls builds. However, there isn't as much depth-of-lore present in Nightreign as compared to other Fromsoft titles. After about 100 hours, the lobby becomes a place where you either spend all your currency on relic gacha where you have a miniscule chance to generate a random relic that synergizes well with itself, or a place where you parkour idly after having exhausted all of the NPC's dialogue as you wait for a match to be found. The late game experience revolves around a hard mode called Deep of Night, which features scaling difficulty and skill based matchmaking. Enemies deal more damage (and stronger variants appear), items found in a run have stronger text but also come with downsides, and unlike the regular mode, your map and your Nightlord (or Everdark Nightlord) are randomly chosen. Victory in Deep of Night will increase your rating until you eventually reach a greater Depth where the challenges scale up even more. Deep of Night runs grant you more currency and will generate more powerful relics that can only be used for Deep of Night runs. I have more than 1000 hours across the entire Souls series, and have beaten many of the games deathless or at soul level 1, but clearing Depth 3 has been personally more challenging than anything else i've done before. TL;DR this is a really great game to casually play with friends that does not require a huge time commitment, but also provides a seriously challenging experience to anyone who wants to lock in. HOP ON NIGHTREIGN

Though I do wish Fromsoft would revisit the game's success and add another expansion or tweak some areas, there's genuinely a lot of love and content here and you could tell from my playtime that I'm a pretty big fan of what we have. FS社在《艾尔登法环》的基础上利用其世界观和核心玩法衍生出了一款创新型玩法的作品《艾尔登法环 黑夜君临》，游戏一改传统魂游的核心玩法，变成了类似网游似的玩法，让三名玩家通过合作的方式在一张地图上进行完全随机化的挑战，并且还增加了大逃杀毒圈的设定，限制玩家的探索区域。游戏的节奏更加明快，玩家首先需要在地图中的各个点位进行搜索，获得多样的物品，提升装备水平，升级角色，提升属性，继而挑战各种各样随机生成的BOSS，并最终击败夜王，完成一局挑战。游戏强合作，强联机，因此单人游玩体验不佳。 [quote][table][tr][th][b] 评测出自： [u]网易 UU 鉴赏家培训计划[/u][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][th][b]感谢由 [u]网易 UU 鉴赏家培训计划[/u] 提供游戏[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][th][b][i] 加速 云存 领游戏，满足 热爱游戏梦！[/i][/b][/th][/tr][/table][/quote] [h1]快节奏的核心玩法[/h1] 本作游戏的核心游玩体验建立在一个极其严苛的三日循环之上。每一局游戏约40分钟左右，玩家需要在有限的时间内完成资源和物品的搜刮，通过击败敌人和各个点位的BOSS提升装备以及等级提升，并在毒圈的逼迫下推进至最终BOSS战对抗夜王。这种类似大逃杀的缩圈机制彻底改变了魂系游戏原本从容的探索节奏。在实际的游玩中，前两日的自由探索时间被压缩到了极致，这导致游戏在体验上不可避免地走向了公式化。玩家们为了在有限的时间内达到足以对抗最终夜王的等级，拥有强大的武器，玩家必须放弃漫无目的的无所谓探索，转而背诵并严格执行最优探图路线。一旦在前期规划失误或遭遇意外，发育不良的滚雪球效应会迅速放大，导致后期面对BOSS时极度乏力。这种极端的效率导向，虽然带来了争分夺秒的紧张感，但也让重复游玩的体验逐渐从乐趣十足滑向百无聊赖，前期的新鲜感很快就会被这种军训似的套路而变得目的性极强反而错失了游戏的体验感。 而游戏作为一款类Roguelite游戏，本作在局内成长与流派构筑上的表现却显得相当保守。游戏内的Build构筑缺乏深度的策略交互，武器副词条与永久Buff都是简单粗暴的纯数值提升。玩家无需进行复杂的机制联动思考，只需遵循哪个数值高拿哪个的原则即可。更令人无奈的是其混乱的奖励池机制，玩家无法直通高收益装备，从而导致了游戏过程中很多遵循运气成分，白白浪费了宝贵的探索时间。 [h1]强合作的三人联机玩法[/h1] 本作游戏最成功的设计之一，是其从单人探索游戏变成了无缝的至多三人合作联机体验。游戏彻底摒弃了繁琐的召唤仪式，三名玩家从开局便共同降生、共同探索。这种深度的合作机制绑定极大地强化了团队合作的必要性，增加了地图上各个点位的探索效率，以及在合作战斗的时候提供了队友复活的机制。当与熟悉的好友组排时，如果有语音的话更佳，默契的配合与互相兜底能让高压的流程转化为纯粹的欢乐。不过本作游戏对于单人玩家就不是很友好了，一方面单人玩家并没有降低战斗和探索的难度，相反一个人需要完成三个人的工作，实际上也让游戏体验堪比上班。 但对于依赖随机匹配的玩家来说，联机体验则充满了不确定性。由于局内缺乏文字或语音交流手段，野排队友的素质完全听天由命。目前游戏已经发售了很长一段时间了，游戏中目前还在坚持游玩的大部分都是十分擅长的老手，但是每次打折的时候也会有大量的萌新玩家加入。匹配的过程中玩家可能会遇到路线清晰、操作扎实的老手，可能全程AFK都能顺利通关。当然玩家也可能匹配到毫无规划、稍遇挫折便直接退出的压力玩家。在极度依赖团队容错率的机制下，一个不靠谱的队友足以让整局40分钟的努力付诸东流。 所以对于本作游戏的联机体验来说，我强烈建议那些愿意投入时间背板、拥有固定队友的硬核玩家，能够接受游戏的公式化与高压，并找到志同道合的伙伴，就是这个游戏最大的乐趣所在。 [h1]游戏缺乏后劲[/h1] 本作游戏推出了这么长时间了，但是游戏的内容与刚刚发售时并没有太多的差别，推出的DLC也仅仅只是增加了2个BOSS和2个新职业，区分度并没有很高，也没有什么实质性的游玩体验的提升。因此在游玩了一定时间之后本作游戏的整体体验是相当重复的，一定程度上缺乏后劲。但是也确实这么长时间以来游戏也并没有更新的迹象，很难不让人怀疑这么一款网游方向的游戏是否已经停止更新，后续玩家购买还需酌情。

This game is basically Elden Ring roguelite co-op chaos, and honestly the real final boss isn’t the Night Lord it’s always my friends (SHOUTOUT to Pratyush,Meet,Atharv n Nikshay) You pick one of eight characters, drop into a run with two other people or maybe more if you are playing with seamless co-op mod on , and try to survive two in-game days You loot, level up, build your setup, and then go fight the Night Lords, Simple idea on paper In reality? It’s pure chaos One friend is looting every random corner like there’s a secret treasure hidden in a bush One is fighting a boss alone with no flasks left And one is somehow lost in a cave while the rest of us are dying outside Then everyone starts spam pinging like that’s going to fix anything And smh that’s the best part. Combat is classic Elden Ring, so it still feels really good Every character plays differently, and when your team actually syncs up, fights feel amazing But that balance doesn’t last long Five minutes later someone dies to something random and it’s back to panic mode The game also doesn’t really teach you much It just drops you in and expects you to figure it out, Most of the time you end up learning stuff from guides or random YouTube videos instead of the game itself or in my case it was my fellow friend Pratyush The relic system is fine but honestly a lot of it feels like junk You get something good once in a while, but most runs you’re just slightly stronger and hoping RNG is nicer next time As a roguelite fan, I’ll say it clearly, it’s actually really good The whole run structure is addictive, and the time pressure makes every decision matter It just doesn’t go fully insane with power scaling But the biggest thing about this game isn’t the systems at all It’s the experience with your FRIENDS Nightreign turns into absolute chaos in discord voice chat Everyone shouting to kill the boss, blaming each other for doing smth random shi-, someone pulling extra enemies, someone refusing to revive because they’re busy looting It’s stressful, funny, and somehow turns into the most memorable part of the whole game The map itself is solid, with raids and things bosses popping up on day 2, but your team will still ignore all logic and run straight into the bosses at level 3-4 smth Now the DLC, Forsaken Hollows The bosses are honestly incredible Some of the best FromSoftware has made. Fast, aggressive, and actually fun to learn (like ED balancers and Dreglord) Every fight feels like it pushes you a bit, but in a good way Easily the highlight of the DLC But the map design- nahhhhhhhhhhhhh It feels like someone built it just to confuse you personally You can see exactly where you need to go, but getting there takes random routes that make no sense at first Simple locations somehow turn into a full expedition You spend half the time just figuring out how to reach things instead of actually doing them At the end of the day, Nightreign is a really solid roguelite co-op game Not perfect, not balanced all the time, but ridiculously fun if you’ve got friends to suffer through it with I’d still give it a 8/10. 玩了五百多小时，前后沉迷这个游戏大概有9个月了，要说不上头是假的，但思来想去，为了列表好友和未入坑玩家的时间，还是决定给差评。这不是泄愤式差评，我会在下文详细说明理由。 [h1] 不建议任何新玩家入坑 [/h1] 先说结论，我不推荐任何没接触过魂系列/法环的玩家入坑，包括两者的轻度玩家，除非你是FS社的忠实受众，魂/环几百上千小时的老ass，实在没游戏玩了，可以尝试，毕竟此时你想必已经是一个抖m了，这一假设的前提是你已经有足够的心理建设，能够接受此游极低的容错率、部分极其大粪的怪和boss、极其糟糕的局外成长系统、糟糕的联机体验，以及堪称史上最恶臭的社区环境之一。 [b]但也不是完全乏善可陈，接下来来说说优点吧：[/b] [h1]1.独家风格的联机合作+跑圈+魂系战斗游戏。[/h1]在市面上没有代餐。魂游的受众不算广，但特点是基本盘扎实，所以继承了很大一批从魂系列和法环来的玩家。对于此类群体，我建议是等降价到100以内入手，游戏发行仅仅不到一年就停止更新内容了，如今完全不值原价，更不用提DLC完全就是负体验（两个新角色如今基本下水道强度、大空洞强制找水晶、排到王仙女你就玩去吧）。 [h1]2.优秀的局内战斗节奏设计和动作。[/h1]作为一个快节奏肉鸽游戏，FS将战斗节奏把控得非常好，尽管一局游戏长达四十多分钟，但你完全不会感觉到无聊，游戏中你需要不断地规划、战斗、跑图，喝口水都会断节奏不是开玩笑的。战斗也非常爽快，角色的技能、各种武器/法术、boss的设计都会在游戏中不断带给你各种挑战和正反馈。 [h1]3.众多的职业、构筑、武器和法术。[/h1]丰富的构筑让你每一局游戏都是不一样的体验，你可以摸到什么玩什么、也可以成为一个赌狗去赌局内的概率，这种未知性让你永远想再开一局，总有意犹未尽的感觉。 [b]接下来就是不吐不快的糟糕部分。[/b] [h1]1.极高的上手门槛和中后期极低的容错。[/h1]入手这个游戏有两大前提，要么你是法环的高手、要么你有朋友带你，游戏少得可怜的新手引导让你几乎不得不上网查各种攻略，否则你会不停地疑问：我在哪、要干嘛。很感谢当初带我入坑的朋友，初期几乎是一步一个标记带着我跑图，让我新手期没那么困难，但即便如此，我也需要自己查询大量的攻略才弄明白这个游戏到底是怎么玩，而到这一步时我已经玩了50+小时了。如果你没玩过法环，那你连打小怪都是个问题。喜欢我红狼无限读指令马拉松吗？喜欢我赵子龙一刀捅穿ass吗？ [h1]2.制作组消极的游戏支持。[/h1]我前文提到此游的流派众多、战斗很爽快上头，但这更多地是站在法环这个巨人的肩膀上，优秀的是法环而不是黑夜君临。如果你没有玩过法环，请你直接入坑艾尔登法环；如果你玩过，那我很遗憾地说，黑夜君临并不是法环的续作，它没有多少实质上的新内容（除了几个全新的boss——夜王，但这只占你一局游戏时间的四分之一）。它并没有得到开发商多少资源的投入，内容大多是缝合前作，而且发售不到一年就停更了。没有新内容的同时。遗物系统、职业平衡、联机体验依然是依托答辩。| [h1]3.傲慢的设计师。[/h1]引用我赞同的另一列表好友的评论：一个PVE游戏非要执着于数值平衡、教玩家玩游戏。花钱买DLC给自己找罪受，买了一个月，两个新角色直接成了下水道。学者本身便秘的性能，要生存没生存要输出没输出，纯辅助工具人，只有投壶有伤害，结果一次更新直接削废（硬要玩就祈祷队友会给你买壶吧）。然后是修女，也基本上是追踪者的下位替代，靠着项链才勉强有强度，结果专属遗物还被削。隔着屏幕都能感觉到制作组的傲慢，不知道的以为是英雄联盟设计师来了。本身DLC的boss还有守门员基本都是鬼屋，蒙格满地拉式一碰就死、A大普通模式都能一刀秒人，更不用提史上最鬼屋的boss设计——王仙女，一对多、毫无交互、只能马拉松、变大区表演纯浪费时间还要被一头创死。纯粹花钱找罪受。 [h1]4.糟糕的局外成长系统——遗物。[/h1]很难想象，作为一款肉鸽游戏，其局外成长的影响如此之大，同时其收集难度又如此之高。哪怕你花了几百上千小时，打上了深夜9999，你可能都还没解锁一半流派的可用遗物，偏偏有的流派没有遗物根本玩不了，而且遗物词条也造成了不同角色的强度差异很大。同时它也是导致恶臭社区环境的罪魁祸首之一（下面会提到）。 [h1]5.糟糕的联机体验。[/h1]继承了前几作的优秀传统，此游的服务器一如既往地糟糕，各种卡顿、延迟，小怪瞬移螺旋升天然后突然出现在你后面把你一刀砍死，救队友救不起来，甚至和队友卡地形、卡异世界。再是交流系统，作为一个联机合作游戏，你和陌生队友沟通的方式仅限于标记地面，没了。没有文字、没有语音。你可以标记地图，也可以把装备放到地上再标记。其余的只能靠意念共鸣。你无法告诉队友你想要什么装备、什么道具（如果你想玩壶人你就祈祷队友会给你买壶吧）。也无法在打不过的时候，告诉队友要撤退，最要命的是，当你和队友的路线出现分歧时，你没有任何办法说服他或者被他说服。 [h1]6.极其恶臭的游戏社区环境。[/h1] 6.1 [h1]Good Spinoff, Bad Roguelite[/h1] I always have a mixed feeling towards Elden Ring Nightreign. The extraction-style gameplay shuns me away for quite a while. But after playing it through, I certainly feel less dismissive about it. On one hand, it's admirable to see FromSoft step out of their comfort zone and try something different. Yet on the other hand, Nightreign is not a particularly good roguelite experience. Even some of the indie brethren can eclipse its effort. Still, Nightreign is an interesting experiment on mixing up different mechanics from popular genres. It's better to bring a friend or two along. Solo is certainly doable, but the learning curve is steep. [h2]Thing I Like About Elden Ring Nightreign:[/h2] [list] [*][b]The Raids:[/b] Now I think about it. The Radahn fight in the base game is definitely the prototype behind Nightreign. You and your friends working together to take on (or cheese the hell out of) a big boss is one of the best moments in the Souls series. Nightreign tries to expertize this experience, and I say it's a job well-done. Scout the map, plan the route, conquer locations, loot the gear, run away from the shrinking zone, defeat two ring bosses, tackle the Nightlord and fail miserably (prerequisite). A complex process on the surface, but with friends you can easily make it fun. Moreover, teamwork has never been more important than ever. Who draws aggro, who deals damage, and when to rotate the roles for breathing room, [strike] and stop going after the Bell-bearing A-hole[/strike] are key to a successful expedition. [*][b]Preset Characters:[/b] I am a little bit sad you can't create your own character, but at least the eight available ones are very unique. Each of them offers a distinctive playstyle and fulfills a certain role in your team. You can find your preferred playstyle in these characters. Moreover, their backstories are also interesting, told through FromSoft's usual storytelling shenanigans, except this time it's rather clear and more involved in the player's part. I like how these people feel like a bunch of misfits bound together by a shared goal. Yet, through remembrance you can easily see how their fate intertwined with each other. [*][b]Combat QOL Improvements:[/b] Now these are something that sparks excitement not only for the game but also for future titles. Nightreign has a lot of improvements on both combat and movement. Instant sprint offers a new way to close gaps and make distance. Jump has been even better at dodging attacks since the inclusion of kick/wall jump. Enemies' grab attacks are now unifyingly color-coded for easier recognition. There's also a red marker on the character indicating who is being targeted by the boss right now. Performing a critical attack no longer makes the enemies invulnerable, meaning your teammates can continuously wail on their downfalls. Whips, shields, and even bows can now backstab, and so on. [/list] [h2]Things I Like And Dislike About Elden Ring Nightreign:[/h2] [list] [*][b]Shifting Earth:[/b] Nightreign's map is pretty stale. The random generation doesn't alter the map layout much, so the developers create this feature to mitigate the problem. Unfortunately, Shifting Earth only achieved half of its goal. For the good parts, these new biomes drastically change parts of Limveld. They offer new terrains, special points of interest and a unique secret buff for you to uncover. However, the way the developers implement leaves a lot to be desired. They are randomized one "period" at a time. The game rolls one event, and the next few runs you will always have this event active (unless you sleep). These new terrains also suffer from the same issue as the mainland—fixed placement and fixed layout. I really wish their locations could be randomized, and the other terrains could have the chance to spawn as sub-areas. [*][b]Nightlords:[/b] Just like the eight playable characters, all eight Nightlords are fantastic in their own way. The classic orchestral bombardment is in full force. Their presentations are easily the most stunning out of all the Souls series. Their move sets are designed to deal with multiple targets at once, and there are actual interesting mechanics woven in to make the fights more dynamic. The only thing I really dislike about the boss design is the cinematic attack—you know, the one where you see the boss fly away and you wait for almost 10 seconds until it lands that one attack. This is a trend I wish Fromsoft would refrain from using too much. It only works once. The second and third times onward just feel like a waste of time. Oh, and also fck Maris. [/list] [h2]Things I Dislike About Elden Ring Nightreign:[/h2] [list] [*][b]Relics:[/b] It's farming blood gems in Chalice Dungeons all over again...except it's worst and takes longer to get. I believe the purpose of the relics is to make your early game as smooth as possible. If that's the case, then there are two problems. First of all, the pool is heavily diluted by tons of weak or borderline useless attributes. Even if you manage to roll a stat-boosting one, the number is still too negligible to make a difference. Second, everything is completely randomized. There is no way to reroll attributes, so the only way to get better relics is gambling. [*][b]Builds:[/b] This might be me not adjusting my mindset accordingly, so take it with a grain of salt. Despite introducing character abilities and passive bonuses, the build flexibility is surprisingly rigid in Nightreign. One of the beautiful things in Souls games is how easily and freely you can change your build. Nightreign doesn't do that. All characters have set stats, and leveling up gives a universal increase to every stat. As a result, it's easier to lean into what the character is already capable of instead of exploring other possibilities. Passives on weapons might enable a certain degree of availability, but it will never be half as good as a dedicated build. [/list] [b]中文小簡評[/b] 一開始《艾爾登法環黑夜君臨》讓我五味雜陳，強調快速清塔撿裝躲圈的設計與FromSoft一貫照自己步調細細探索的作風大相逕庭，讓我望之卻步，直到夏特才決定入手來體驗，把玩幾場後我算是體悟出箇中滋味。《黑夜君臨》是FromSoft踏出舒適圈的一次大膽嘗試，將既有的魂系戰鬥與現今較熱門遊戲類別的機制加以融合，的確打造出獨具風味的遊戲體驗，這份勇氣值得嘉許。然而以roguelite的角度去看的話機制非常不成熟，幾乎被其他獨立同儕輾壓。不過最好還是拉個朋友一起入坑，單人打可行，就是學習曲線過於坎坷。 [b]喜歡的點[/b] [list] [*]現在想來，《艾爾登法環》裡的碎星Boss戰應該就是《黑夜君臨》的藍圖吧！和朋友一起挑戰（或用各種外鄉手段）打Boss絕對是魂系遊戲中最最棒的體驗之一。《黑夜君臨》在這點上就發揮的淋漓盡致，一起觀察地形、一起規劃路線、一起分工、一起跑圈撿裝、一起打黑夜王然後再一起被壓在地上磨擦。 [*]這也是歷代魂系中最講究團隊合作的重要性，誰負責坦傷、誰負責輸出、何時要輪替吸仇恨製造喘息空間、誰要去阻止隊友在等級太低的情況下還敢去打鈴珠獵人和龍形大樹守衛，這些流程看似複雜，但和朋友一同經歷就能充分享受其中樂趣。 [*]不能自創角色有點可惜，但遊戲提供的八位主角各具特色，各自擁有鮮明的定位與專精的武器，絕對能讓你找到自己心儀的玩法。此外，他們的背景故事也很有趣，除了FromSoftware一往的敘事手法外，也加入了許多互動要素，讓你能更清楚了解他們。我意外地滿喜歡這群看似格格不入的烏合之眾，只是因為共同的目標而聚集在一起。然而，透過追憶你就能明白他們彼此的命運緊密交織在一起。 [*]不過我最喜歡的還是本作在戰鬥方面做的各種改良，像是瞬間衝刺讓你能快速逃離或拉近與Boss間的距離、、敵人抓技有用更鮮明的特效顯示、Boss打出大招時也能清楚看出誰被鎖定、爆擊或背刺敵人時隊友可以無視無敵禎盡情輸出等，這些都是很棒的設計，讓人非常期待FromSoft未來遊戲的走向。 [/list] [b]又愛又恨的點[/b] [list] [*]《黑夜君臨》的地圖變化隨機性低且非常單調，通常走過一次就能輕鬆記起來，因此製作團隊想用「特異地形」來做點變化，我只能說這項設計只做到一半。先說優點，特異地形的確有效改變部分主地圖的地形，加入了新敵人、新地點以及專屬隱藏增益讓你能在規劃路線上做些改變。但是呢，特異地形是以隨機「週期性」的方式出現， 一旦條件生成你接下來的所有行動都會是出同一個地形，而且這些特異地形也跟主地圖有同樣的問題：位置與分部始終固定，沒有隨機地點，也沒有隨機生成特殊子區域實屬可惜。 [*]黑夜王的表現各有千秋，氣勢與演出絕對不輸FromSoft過去的經典Boss，配樂一個比一個還有特色，招式上不僅充分考量「一對多」的要素，也成功融入有趣且非一面倒的機制，這在正統魂系中可是非常少見的。缺點的話，我覺得FromSoft可以少用點浮誇的攻擊，這裡是指那種Boss會突然走遠遠的開始搞一些很炫泡的前置，然後過來打你一下。第一次感覺很新鮮很壯麗，但兩、三次後難免會覺得有點浪費時間。 [/list] [b]不喜歡的點[/b] [list] [*]遺物機制根本就是下位版的金盃刷血寶石啊！即使退一萬步說遺物的功能只是用來讓你前期好過一些好了，詞條全靠隨機生成，既沒有鎖詞條重刷其他欄位的功能，還將一些改變角色技藝或絕活的重要詞條與一堆非常無用的詞條放在一起，讓人刷起來非常氣餒。 [*]這點應該歸究於我個人心境還沒調適過來。《黑夜君臨》看似有許多被動與技能可搭配，實際上角色流派的多樣性與變化性比想像中來的侷限。本作不像《艾爾登法環》可以隨時隨地改變配點裝備，角色初始數值固定，升等也自動幫你配好點，與其探索其他可能性倒不如更專心玩角色已經擅長的流派。 [/list] [quote=author]If you like what I write, please consider a follow to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45738167/]my curator[/url] page, thanks! 如果你喜歡我寫的東西，可以追蹤[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45738167/]我的鑑賞家[/url]喔！[/quote]

根据我目前为止的游玩时长来看的话，其实我还没有能评价黑环的资格，不过还是想讲一下自己的感受。 首先这个游戏刚出的时候我就买了，但可惜他几乎是强制要求三人一起玩，再加上我不愿野排，导致了我应该是错过了他的黄金期。很长一段时间他都在我的游戏库里没有打开过。 终于我鼓起勇气找到了很多现在依然愿意玩这个游戏的陌生人，有一些老玩家愿意带我，真的很感谢你们。测评里面大部分人诟病的野排问题，我到现在暂时还未被伤害到。 如果有想要入坑或者不想被这个问题困扰的话，我诚心建议你们先去找合拍的人再开启这段旅行。大部分的玩家还是很友好包容的，我跟着老师们短短几十个小时，就已经完全能上手不拖后腿，并且慢慢体会到了这个游戏的乐趣。 一起努力打boss，摸球摸出好武器好词条，就算死了也很搞笑，两个区一扭一扭的靠在一起等大腿骂骂咧咧的来救，会为遗物发愁，从来没有因为输了不开心。 我很怀念像笨蛋一样的跟着老玩家一起跑的日子，什么都不懂，只要吃的上贡品（球）就好啦，打败boss之后说我们三个真厉害，虽然有些人只和我玩了几局就没喊我玩了，但我依旧很感谢你们。 我认为黑环的可玩性和复玩性还是很高的，里面的剧情虽然不多但也能从零碎的章节里拼凑出每个人的故事（孪生双马我真哭死）。战斗部分的时间紧凑，缩圈跑毒，能带的武器物品有限制，每一局会得到什么也无从知晓，真的很戳我这个赌狗，也强制我学习各种流派打法，短时内思考最优解。最终夜王的演出也相当精彩（谁懂我第一次看老不开天时的震撼）。当然最重要的是，我觉得我比在法环时更强了（我要目压一切！） 单单我说的以上这些就足以我为他打上好评，有些不足也完全瑕不掩瑜（何况我为王就要有为王的气量嘻嘻） 说个题外话，我通关法环很久了，做完全成就之后就没打开过，每当我想再次打开时，一股深深的孤独感萦绕着我，在一开始，应该陪伴我左右的女巫就离开了我，路上遇到的所有人，朋友，敌人，帮助过我的人，我帮助过的人，不是没了就是再也无法见面了，我还剩什么呢？ 我成王了，小木头呢？早就为我而死了，那个永远在追寻理想路上的亚历山大呢？碎了，告诉我无论是否成王也能回到她身边的老师呢？也没了，什么都没了。 打败皮蛋的一瞬我是开心的，但立刻一股空落落的孤寂颖上心头。出门遇到的所有人要么不认识我，攻击我，要么继续反复念叨着我未成王时的台词，谁在打心底的为我欢呼呢？谁又依然陪伴我身边呢？我最敬佩的敌人也早就化成了灰，我什么都没有了。 黑环却给了我永远都会在的同行者，我成功失败，总会伴我身侧。 宁姆韦德的雨似乎停了

嘿嘿，写下测评。 虽然不是一个发售即入，没有跟着开荒过的老玩家，但后来也算没看攻略跟朋友双排慢慢摸索完了不管是运营思路也好，夜王打法也罢，或者是不同地形的跑图，都差不多是自己在宁姆韦德一步一步跑出来的了。我对这个游戏不做推荐，或者说我其实对任何游戏都不做推荐，只有自己体验过了才知道它是好是坏，但在我心里这个游戏是好评，不管是奔着fs的名头魂游的名头我都很喜欢它。 这条测评更多的是想写一下五百个小时的心路历程。刚开始玩那会其实蛮崩溃的，找不到路，不知道怎么打，遗物也不好，还跟着骂过遗物系统，只会公式打小教堂然后清主城，绝大部分的早期截图都升不到满级哈哈，但那个时候刚入坑觉得什么都新鲜，很有意思。后来深夜出了，开始双排上分。刚出深夜的时候套路也不成熟，靠着浅夜输了不掉分跟朋友爬上深三。那个时候伤害最高的是监牢罪人流，我也靠着这套遗物打到深四。在技术勉勉强强的时候打到深四也很开心:)。后来出了dlc，那个时候因为只想打深夜，很多时候适应不了不管是大空洞还是锻造村之类的小地形导致一直在输，朋友没啥兴趣就跟着退坑了一段时间。回坑又是因为双安定太强了，玩战技无脑上了深五。那段时间算是最厉害的了，狂到遗物出了双安定没啥特点也能随便赢，找到光环镰刀了也丢给队友玩。但到现在，虽然没打上49，其实已经有些累了，以前能单刷的夜王现在进去就要躺地上，伤害也打不出来，被打的没自信了:(有些可惜玩了这么久的追踪者没带着他渡过黑夜。 另一点是社区环境，虽然我其实不混社区，玩了这么久本质高手也排过，单走神人也排过，ce神族也排过，遇到高手了会很开心，感觉能遇到这么厉害的人很荣幸然后有机会的话会加别人好友虽然其实很少一起玩（遇到神人了其实拉黑就好了，对我来说如果没有赢我会想会不会是哪里没做好= =，所以没有必要被其他人影响，我打的菜了也会去跟别人说抱歉，相信一起渡夜的大火都是好人^-^ （附：还有讨厌的服务器😡，有时候遇到卡比或者自己卡炸房了连不回去白白掉分，fs真坏） 希望我的测评能对所有的渡夜者有帮助，不管你是没上深五希望能挑战自己的人还是本质高手还是想入坑的新手。法环dlc里有句话我很喜欢，在落叶丹恩的前面写的：“持续磨炼自己，不要懈怠。”不管是这场游戏还是未来，永远相信长夜临光。 如果我的测评能有幸被你看到，欢迎来找我玩*=v=*
